visual_action: A slideshow of photos of Joe Biden, primarily showing him signing documents or in other presidential settings. On the left side of the screen, a dark blue vertical bar displays a scrolling list of accomplishments. In every photo, a sticker of Joe Biden pointing with the text "I DID THAT!" is superimposed on his tie.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown in the video montage and the on-screen text lists his alleged accomplishments.

cast.name: al-Qaeda
cast.evidence: The on-screen text lists "Took out the leader of al-Qaeda" as an accomplishment.

cast.name: NATO
cast.evidence: The on-screen text lists "Expanded the NATO alliance" as an accomplishment.

cast.name: Medicare
cast.evidence: The on-screen text lists accomplishments related to Medicare, such as "Allowed Medicare to negotiate lower drug price".

cast.name: Supreme Court
cast.evidence: The on-screen text mentions the "Confirmation of first Black woman to Supreme Court".

on_screen_text.text: First major gun safety legislation in decades
Took out the leader of al-Qaeda
Confirmation of first Black woman to Supreme Court
United our allies in support of Ukraine
Reauthorized the Violence Against Women Act
Allowed Medicare to negotiate lower drug price
Capped the cost of insulin for Medicare recipients
Implemented a ban on surprise health insurance bills
Banned chokeholds and no-knock raids for federal law enforcement
Signed executive orders to protect reproductive rights
Raised the minimum wage for federal contractors to $15/hr
Issued historic executive order advancing LGBTQ+ equality
All jobs lost in the pandemic recovered

spoken_summary: The audio features a repetitive "bing bong" sound effect that layers and builds in intensity, accompanied by an electronic beat. Partway through, a male voice exclaims what sounds like, "Suck it, baby!"
audio_music: The audio is built around the "bing bong" meme sound effect, which repeats and layers on top of itself to create a driving, rhythmic beat. An electronic drum track joins in, increasing the energy. The overall effect is high-energy, confident, and celebratory, functioning as hype music for the list of accomplishments shown on screen.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced slideshow of still images of Joe Biden, with cuts synchronized to the beat of the audio. The on-screen text also appears sequentially, matching the rapid rhythm.
manipulation_or_satire: A sticker showing a small image of Joe Biden pointing, with the text "I DID THAT!", is digitally superimposed onto his tie in every photograph. This sticker is part of a well-known political meme, which is being reappropriated here.
cultural_references: "I DID THAT!" sticker meme, originally used by critics to blame Joe Biden for high gas prices, is reappropriated here.
The "Bing Bong" audio, a popular TikTok sound originating from a viral video of a New York Knicks fan.
The phrase "Suck it, baby!" appears to be a reference to the catchphrase of professional wrestler Triple H and the wrestling group D-Generation X.
central_claim: The Biden administration has a long list of significant accomplishments which it is proudly claiming credit for, directly countering criticism by using a meme originally created by opponents.
intended_effect: To make supporters feel proud and confident in the Biden administration's record and to reframe a negative meme into a positive symbol of achievement.
